web.joinBody: Log in or create an account to like, comment, save posts, and chat with creators.
web.mobileBody: Keep exploring here. Download ChatAndTip to interact with posts and chat with creators.
web.exploreIntro: Watch, discover and connect with creators.
web.legalNote: The full official policy below is provided in English.
web.aboutBody: ChatAndTip brings creators and communities together through posts, conversations and support. Explore photos and videos, discover new voices, and connect through the app.
web.faq1q: Can I watch without an account?
web.faq1a: Yes. Public photos and videos, information pages and policies are available without logging in.
web.faq2q: How do I interact with a post?
web.faq2a: On a computer, log in or create an account. On a mobile browser, download the app to like, comment, share, save and chat.
web.faq3q: Why is a video waiting for a click?
web.faq3a: Some browsers require a click before playing sound. Use the play or retry button to start the video.
web.faq4a: Visit Contact us to send a message to the ChatAndTip team.
web.name: Full name
web.sent: Message sent. Our team will reply by email.

web.contactBody: Questions, feedback or a partnership idea? Send a message to the ChatAndTip team.
